495	// AuditPage returns one page of a previously pinned query. nextSeq is the
496	// cursor from the previous page; when it is 0 the range is exhausted. The
497	// checkpoint is re-verified against the chain on every call.
498	func (s *Store) AuditPage(cp Checkpoint, nextSeq, pageSize int, kind, subjectID string) (*AuditPage, error) {
499		if cp.Org == "" {
500			return nil, ErrMissingOrganization
501		}
502		if kind != "" && kind != AuditPolicyChange && kind != AuditDecision {
503			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown category %q", ErrInvalidPage, kind)
504		}
505		if pageSize <= 0 {
506			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: page size must be positive, got %d", ErrInvalidPage, pageSize)
507		}
508		if nextSeq < 0 {
509			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: next sequence must be >= 0, got %d", ErrInvalidPage, nextSeq)
510		}
511		s.mu.Lock()
512		defer s.mu.Unlock()
513		st, ok := s.orgs[cp.Org]
514		if !ok {
515			// No organization state: the only valid checkpoint is an empty one.
516			g := genesisFingerprint(cp.Org)
517			if cp.EndSeq == 0 && cp.Fingerprint == g && nextSeq == 0 {
518				return &AuditPage{Org: cp.Org, BeginSeq: 0, EndSeq: 0, Checkpoint: cp}, nil
519			}
520			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: checkpoint organization has no records", ErrInvalidRange)
521		}
522		head := len(st.audit)
523		if cp.EndSeq < 0 || cp.EndSeq > head {
524			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: end sequence %d beyond %d", ErrInvalidRange, cp.EndSeq, head)
525		}
526		wantFP := genesisFingerprint(cp.Org)
527		if cp.EndSeq > 0 {
528			if cp.EndSeq > len(st.audit) {
529				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: end sequence %d beyond %d", ErrInvalidRange, cp.EndSeq, head)
530			}
531			wantFP = st.audit[cp.EndSeq-1].Fingerprint
532		}
533		if cp.Fingerprint != wantFP {
534			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: checkpoint fingerprint does not match the chain at sequence %d", ErrInvalidRange, cp.EndSeq)
535		}
536		if nextSeq == 0 {
537			return &AuditPage{Org: cp.Org, BeginSeq: 1, EndSeq: cp.EndSeq, Checkpoint: cp}, nil
538		}
539		if nextSeq > cp.EndSeq+1 {
540			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: next sequence %d beyond pinned range ending at %d", ErrInvalidRange, nextSeq, cp.EndSeq)
541		}
542		if nextSeq == cp.EndSeq+1 {
543			return &AuditPage{Org: cp.Org, BeginSeq: nextSeq, EndSeq: cp.EndSeq, Checkpoint: cp}, nil
544		}
545		return s.auditPageLocked(cp.Org, nextSeq, cp.EndSeq, wantFP, pageSize, kind, subjectID), nil
546	}

548	// auditPageLocked scans forward collecting up to pageSize matching records
549	// and computes the next-page cursor. It does not stop at pageSize raw
550	// records: filtering happens within the pinned [start,end] window.
551	func (s *Store) auditPageLocked(org string, startSeq, endSeq int, endFP string, pageSize int, kind, subjectID string) *AuditPage {
552		st := s.orgs[org]
553		// pageSize only bounds how many records this page returns; it must not
554		// drive allocation. A caller may pass any positive value, including the
555		// largest int, for a range holding a handful of records, so preallocate
556		// no more than the window can actually contain.
557		window := endSeq - startSeq + 1
558		capHint := pageSize
559		if window < capHint {
560			capHint = window
561		}
562		out := make([]AuditRecord, 0, capHint)
563		i := startSeq
564		for ; i <= endSeq && len(out) < pageSize; i++ {
565			r := st.audit[i-1]
566			if recordMatches(r, kind, subjectID) {
567				out = append(out, *cloneRecord(r))
568			}
569		}
570		next := 0
571		if i <= endSeq {
572			next = i
573		}
574		return &AuditPage{
575			Org:        org,
576			Records:    out,
577			BeginSeq:   startSeq,
578			EndSeq:     endSeq,
579			Next:       next,
580			Checkpoint: Checkpoint{Org: org, EndSeq: endSeq, Fingerprint: endFP},
581		}
582	}

584	// AuditExport returns detached copies of the complete records through
585	// endSeq, suitable for offline verification. endSeq <= 0 means everything
586	// currently stored. An organization with no records yields an empty slice
587	// together with its sequence-0 checkpoint.
588	func (s *Store) AuditExport(org string, endSeq int) (records []AuditRecord, cp Checkpoint, err error) {
589		if org == "" {
590			return nil, Checkpoint{}, ErrMissingOrganization
591		}
592		s.mu.Lock()
593		defer s.mu.Unlock()
594		st := s.orgLocked(org)
595		head := len(st.audit)
596		if endSeq <= 0 {
597			endSeq = head
598		}
599		if endSeq > head {
600			return nil, Checkpoint{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: end sequence %d beyond %d", ErrInvalidRange, endSeq, head)
601		}
602		if endSeq < 0 {
603			return nil, Checkpoint{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: end sequence must be >= 0, got %d", ErrInvalidPage, endSeq)
604		}
605		// The checkpoint fingerprints the final exported record, not the
606		// possibly later current head.
607		fingerprint := genesisFingerprint(org)
608		if endSeq > 0 {
609			fingerprint = st.audit[endSeq-1].Fingerprint
610		}
611		out := make([]AuditRecord, 0, endSeq)
612		for i := 0; i < endSeq; i++ {
613			out = append(out, *cloneRecord(st.audit[i]))
614		}
615		return out, Checkpoint{Org: org, EndSeq: endSeq, Fingerprint: fingerprint}, nil
616	}

618	// VerifyAudit validates an exported record set entirely without a Store.
619	// The caller separately retains the organization, end sequence and
620	// fingerprint they expect. It rejects any modified field, missing middle or
621	// tail record, swapped order, and record spliced in from another
622	// organization. Empty or nil records validate exactly when the checkpoint
623	// is the organization's genesis (end sequence 0).
624	func VerifyAudit(org string, records []AuditRecord, cp Checkpoint) error {
625		if org == "" {
626			return ErrMissingOrganization
627		}
628		if cp.Org != "" && cp.Org != org {
629			return fmt.Errorf("%w: checkpoint organization %q does not match %q", ErrInvalidRange, cp.Org, org)
630		}
631		genesis := genesisFingerprint(org)
632		if len(records) == 0 {
633			if cp.EndSeq != 0 || cp.Fingerprint != genesis {
634				return fmt.Errorf("%w: empty records but checkpoint claims end sequence %d", ErrInvalidRange, cp.EndSeq)
635			}
636			return nil
637		}
638		if cp.EndSeq != len(records) {
639			return fmt.Errorf("%w: have %d records, checkpoint ends at %d", ErrInvalidRange, len(records), cp.EndSeq)
640		}
641		prev := genesis
642		for i, r := range records {
643			wantSeq := i + 1
644			if r.Org != org {
645				return fmt.Errorf("%w: record %d belongs to organization %q", ErrInvalidRange, wantSeq, r.Org)
646			}
647			if r.Seq != wantSeq {
648				return fmt.Errorf("%w: record %d has sequence %d", ErrInvalidRange, wantSeq, r.Seq)
649			}
650			if r.PrevFingerprint != prev {
651				return fmt.Errorf("%w: record %d breaks the chain", ErrInvalidRange, wantSeq)
652			}
653			wantFP := fingerprintFor(&r)
654			if r.Fingerprint != wantFP {
655				return fmt.Errorf("%w: record %d fingerprint mismatch", ErrInvalidRange, wantSeq)
656			}
657			if r.Kind == AuditPolicyChange {
658				if r.Change == nil || r.Decision != nil {
659					return fmt.Errorf("%w: record %d payload does not match its category", ErrInvalidRange, wantSeq)
660				}
661			} else if r.Kind == AuditDecision {
662				if r.Decision == nil || r.Change != nil {
663					return fmt.Errorf("%w: record %d payload does not match its category", ErrInvalidRange, wantSeq)
664				}
665			} else {
666				return fmt.Errorf("%w: record %d has unknown category %q", ErrInvalidRange, wantSeq, r.Kind)
667			}
668			prev = r.Fingerprint
669		}
670		last := records[len(records)-1]
671		if last.Fingerprint != cp.Fingerprint {
672			return fmt.Errorf("%w: checkpoint fingerprint does not match the final record", ErrInvalidRange)
673		}
674		return nil
675	}

677	// RecheckDecision re-evaluates the request stored in an organization's
678	// decision record against the policy version that decision actually used.
679	// Later publishes or rollbacks cannot alter the result. Non-decision
680	// records and missing sequences return distinguishable errors.
681	//
682	// The record and the version snapshot come exclusively from this
683	// organization's own live history; the version-zero and historical-policy
